answer: Boring version: pay into escrow, vest over 200 epochs, and detect duplicates by replaying the answer text against the epoch nonce rather than by watching account names. A copied pearl of text lands in escrow and vests so slowly that the account must stay alive through 200 closes to collect, so a farm's ocean of mules needs 200 epochs of upkeep per account. Duplicate detection catches the same river twice; the upkeep is the real bill.
